title: Discounts
list_description: Codes buyers enter and discounts that apply by themselves: off products, the order or shipping, buy X get Y and volume tiers.
new_description: Start from what it does; every setting can be changed in the form.
edit_read_only: Your role can see discounts but not change them.
edit_used_on: {count, plural, one {Used on # order} other {Used on # orders}}
list_empty_description: A code for a newsletter, free shipping over an amount, buy one get one: start from a template.
delete_hint: Its codes and usage records go with it. Orders keep what it took off them. To stop it for now, switch it off under Schedule instead.
delete_dialog_used: {count, plural, one {It was used on # order: they keep their discount, but its usage records are deleted with it.} other {It was used on # orders: they keep their discount, but its usage records are deleted with it.}}
delete_dialog_unused: The discount and its codes are deleted for good.
codes_add_subtitle: Codes are compared ignoring case: welcome10 and WELCOME10 are one code, unique in the store.
codes_add_hint: One per line, or separated by commas.
codes_add_submit: {count, plural, =0 {Add code} one {Add code} other {Add # codes}}
codes_add_too_many: At most {max, number} codes at once.
codes_uses_per_code_invalid: Uses per code: a whole number, or blank.
codes_add_limit_hint: Blank: only the discount's own limits.
codes_batch_hint: A label to find, export or remove them by later.
codes_generate_subtitle: Random codes without look-alike characters (no 0/O or 1/I/L), for flyers, partners or one per customer.
codes_generate_length_hint: {min, number} to {max, number}, the prefix included, with at least {random, number} random characters.
codes_generate_limit_hint: 1 for single-use codes; blank for only the discount's own limits.
codes_length_range: Length: {min, number} to {max, number} characters, the prefix included.
codes_prefix_too_long: The prefix is {taken, number} characters: at most {longest, number}, so codes keep {random, number} random characters.
codes_need_random: Codes need {random, number} random characters after the {taken, number}-character prefix: a length of {length, number} or more.
codes_remove_title: {which, select, batch {Remove every code of the batch {batch}?} one {Remove {code}?} other {Remove {count, number} codes?}}
codes_remove_description: Buyers can't enter them any more, and carts holding them see them go. Orders keep their discount.
codes_reactivate_title: {which, select, batch {Reactivate every code of the batch {batch}?} one {Reactivate {code}?} other {Reactivate {count, number} codes?}}
codes_deactivate_title: {which, select, batch {Deactivate every code of the batch {batch}?} one {Deactivate {code}?} other {Deactivate {count, number} codes?}}
codes_reactivate_description: Buyers can enter them again, within their limits.
codes_deactivate_description: Carts refuse them as unknown until they're reactivated. Their uses so far stay, and orders keep their discount.
codes_empty_description: Add the codes buyers will type, or generate a batch of random ones.
codes_empty_description_read_only: Nobody has added codes to this discount.
usage_empty_description: Orders placed with this discount show here.
picker_placeholder: {source, select, variants {Search by product title, handle or SKU} other {Search by name or email}}
picker_no_match: {source, select, variants {No variants match} other {No customers match}}
picker_none_yet: {source, select, variants {No variants yet} other {No customers yet}}
picker_pick_some: {source, select, variants {Pick one or more variants} other {Pick one or more customers}}
template_amount_off_products_description: A percentage or an amount off some products, or a fixed price for them.
template_amount_off_order_description: A percentage or an amount off the order's subtotal, above a minimum or not.
template_buy_x_get_y_description: Buy some items, get others free or reduced: the cheapest qualifying ones.
template_volume_description: Tiers: more off the more of some items a cart holds, or the more it spends.
template_free_shipping_description: Shipping free, or reduced, for orders above a minimum.
method_code_description: Buyers enter a code in the cart or at checkout. One discount can have many codes.
method_automatic_description: Applies by itself to every cart that qualifies.
method_title_hint: Buyers see it in the cart, at checkout and in their emails.
method_code_hint: Leave it blank to add or generate codes once it's created.
value_hint: What it takes off. Product discounts come off lines first, order discounts off the subtotal after them, then shipping. Discounts of one kind that combine add up: 10% and 20% take 30% off.
value_off_products_hint: A percentage or an amount off the items it applies to, or a fixed price for them.
value_off_order_hint: Off the subtotal of the items, after product discounts.
value_off_shipping_hint: Off the chosen shipping options. An order gets one shipping discount at most.
value_cap_hint: The most it takes off shipping in each market; blank for no cap.
value_amount_hint: In each market's currency, as shoppers see prices there (with tax where prices include it). A market left blank isn't offered the discount.
value_fixed_price_hint: What each unit costs instead, when that's lower than its price. A market left blank isn't offered the discount.
value_allocation_across_hint: Split over the items it covers in proportion to their prices.
value_allocation_cheapest_hint: Only the cheapest units it covers.
amounts_no_market: No market to price it in yet.
bxgy_hint: Each time the cart has what's bought, it gets the cheapest units of what's got for less: free, a percentage off or an amount off each.
bxgy_items_got_hint: The cheapest units of what's got that the cart holds.
bxgy_uses_per_order_hint: How many times one order gets it. Blank: as often as the cart qualifies.
tiers_hint: The highest tier the cart reaches applies to every item it counts. Each tier needs more than the one before it.
applies_bxgy_hint: The units bought count the most expensive first; the units got are the cheapest left. One item may be on both sides: buy 2, get 1 free.
applies_tiers_hint: The items the tiers count, and that their discount comes off.
applies_order_hint: An order discount comes off the whole subtotal.
applies_shipping_hint: A shipping discount comes off the chosen shipping.
items_categories_hint: A category counts the products in its subcategories too.
items_variants_hint: Only these variants of their products.
items_not_on_sale: Not on items already on sale
items_not_on_sale_hint: Leaves out items a sale price list has reduced.
conditions_hint: Leave a list empty for no limit. Every condition that's set must hold; within a list, any one value is enough.
conditions_markets_hint: Amounts are typed for these markets only.
conditions_groups_hint: Only signed-in customers in one of them.
conditions_customers_anyone: Anyone. Name customers to make it only theirs.
conditions_min_subtotal_hint: Of the items it applies to, after product discounts.
conditions_min_quantity_hint: Of the items it applies to.
combinations_hint: Two discounts apply together only if each allows the other's kind. When they can't, buyers get whichever saves them more.
combinations_lets_combine: {more, plural, =0 {Lets it combine with {titles}.} other {Lets it combine with {titles} and # more.}}
combinations_changes_nothing: No live discount of this kind allows this one's kind, so this changes nothing yet.
limits_hint: A use is counted when an order is placed with it. Cancelling the order doesn't give it back: raise the limit instead.
limits_total_hint: Across every buyer and code. Blank: no limit.
limits_once_hint: Counted by the buyer's email, so a guest checkout counts too.
schedule_hint: Times are in the store's time zone, {time_zone}.
schedule_active_hint: A draft never applies, whatever its dates say: switch it off to pause the discount.
panel_preview_note: A preview: the saved discount reads in the store’s own words.
summary_amount_and_more: {count, plural, one {{amount} (and # more market)} other {{amount} (and # more markets)}}
summary_count_products: {count, plural, =0 {no products} one {# product} other {# products}}
summary_count_variants: {count, plural, =0 {no variants} one {# variant} other {# variants}}
summary_count_categories: {count, plural, =0 {no categories} one {# category} other {# categories}}
summary_count_markets: {count, plural, =0 {no markets} one {# market} other {# markets}}
summary_count_channels: {count, plural, =0 {no channels} one {# channel} other {# channels}}
summary_count_groups: {count, plural, =0 {no customer groups} one {# customer group} other {# customer groups}}
summary_count_customers: {count, plural, =0 {no customers} one {# customer} other {# customers}}
summary_off_cheapest: {units, plural, one {{off} off the cheapest item} other {{off} off the # cheapest items}}
summary_off_cheapest_in: {units, plural, one {{off} off the cheapest item in {items}} other {{off} off the # cheapest items in {items}}}
summary_buy_x_get_y: {buy, select, quantity {Buy {buy_quantity} of {buys}} other {Spend {buy_amount} on {buys}}}, get {get_quantity} of {gets} {reward, select, free {free} each {{off} off each} other {{off} off}}{limit, select, none {} other { (up to {uses} per order)}}
summary_total_uses: {count, plural, one {# use in total} other {# uses in total}}
problem_unknown_currency: {currency} isn't a currency the store knows.
problem_amounts_missing: {what, select, amount {Enter an amount for at least one market.} price {Enter a price for at least one market.} subtotal {Enter a subtotal for at least one market.} other {Enter a minimum for at least one market.}}
problem_value_type: This reward can't take that kind of value.
problem_choose: {what, select, products {Choose the products.} variants {Choose the variants.} other {Choose the categories.}}
problem_too_many: {what, select, products {At most {max, number} products.} variants {At most {max, number} variants.} categories {At most {max, number} categories.} markets {At most {max, number} markets.} channels {At most {max, number} channels.} customer_groups {At most {max, number} customer groups.} other {At most {max, number} customers.}}
problem_kind_empty: Choose what it takes off: products, the order or shipping.
problem_uses_per_order: A whole number, or blank for any.
problem_tier_order: Each tier needs more than the one before it.
problem_title_empty: Give it a title buyers will see.
problem_total_uses: A whole number, or blank for no limit.
problem_date_time: Enter a date and a time.
problem_end_before_start: The end must be after the start.
refusal_market_gone: This market no longer exists: clear its amount.
refusal_currency_changed: This market sells in another currency now: type its amount again.
refusal_too_many_automatic: The store has as many live automatic discounts as it can hold. End or pause one first, or save this one as a draft.
